IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Labor, Commerce & Consumer Protection.

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning evaluating military training and experience toward meeting certain professional licensing requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to evaluating military training and experiencetoward meeting licensing requirements; adding a new section to chapter18.16 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 18.43 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 18.170 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall develop a process to evaluate military trainingand experience that may be applied toward meeting the training andeducational requirements of this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board shall develop a process to evaluate military training andexperience that may be applied toward meeting the training andeducational requirements of this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.170 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall develop a process to evaluate militarytraining and experience that may be applied toward meeting the trainingand educational requirements of this chapter.
